lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. These centroids form a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density and larger diameter blobs concentrated in the central-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs; the high-intensity circular centroids are primarily positioned in the darker, lower-intensity vertical channels between these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient where a bright upper ridge edge casts a distinct shadow directly below it.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal teleost fish (Echeneidae) located ventrally to the right pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral midline.
